en.meta_description: Practical fixed-scope international growth systems for small businesses.
en.eyebrow: Small, fixed-scope systems for international readiness
en.hero_title: Make your business easier to understand, follow up and sell internationally.
en.hero_body: Start with a focused audit, a usable CRM or a clear sales document. No oversized consulting programme and no fabricated promises.
en.alpha_note: Validation alpha: the public form cannot transmit data yet.
en.principle_1_body: Clear output, timeframe and revision limit.
en.principle_2_body: Recommendations linked to observable business problems.
en.principle_3_body: Automation accelerates work; it does not replace final judgement.
en.services_body: Prices, scope and delivery windows are loaded from one versioned service catalogue.
en.neural_title: Find the smallest useful first service.
en.neural_body: A local CNN and service relationship graph compare your operational priorities. This step asks for no name, email, company or website and transmits nothing.
en.neural_safety_body: Inference runs in this browser. Recommendations are directional and remain subject to human review.
en.neural_goal_sales: Create a clear international sales message
en.neural_choose_service: Use this service in the assessment
en.neural_selection_applied: The recommended service has been selected in the assessment form.
en.neural_local_status: Recommendation generated locally; no information was transmitted.
en.neural_human_review: A human should confirm scope and suitability.
en.neural_reason_visibility: Strong match for international website clarity and trust.
en.neural_reason_follow_up: Strong match for lead organisation and follow-up discipline.
en.neural_reason_sales_message: Strong match for commercial narrative and sales clarity.
en.neural_reason_contact_speed: Strong match for faster, more consistent enquiry handling.
en.neural_reason_low_complexity: Can start with relatively low implementation complexity.
en.neural_reason_profitability: Balances price sensitivity with a useful commercial output.
en.fit_kicker: Designed for a narrow starting point
en.fit_title: Useful when the problem is concrete and the next action is unclear.
en.fit_yes_1: Small or owner-led business with a real website, offer or lead list.
en.fit_yes_2: A bounded commercial problem that can be improved in days, not months.
en.fit_yes_3: Willingness to provide inputs and review one controlled draft.
en.fit_no_1: Guaranteed sales, grants, investors or institutional introductions.
en.fit_no_2: Large custom software, advertising management or full rebranding.
en.step1_body: Confirm the business, problem, target and required inputs.
en.step2_body: Agree the fixed deliverable, exclusions, timing and price.
en.step3_body: Use structured research, templates and controlled automation.
en.step4_body: Human quality control before delivery and one bounded revision.
en.examples_title: Proof of method, not invented client claims.
en.examples_body: These previews describe the intended outputs. They contain no private client information, testimonials or claimed results.
en.assessment_body: Use the form to test the experience. In demonstration mode, the information remains in your browser and is not transmitted.
en.demo_mode_body: No endpoint is configured. Submitting only validates the form locally.
en.live_mode_body: A configured endpoint will receive the request after validation. Human review remains mandatory.
en.form_help: Required fields are marked with an asterisk.
en.field_demo_acknowledgement: I understand this demonstration does not send or retain my entries.
en.field_consent: I agree that these details may be used to review and answer this request.
en.footer_note: Validation-stage business infrastructure. No client claims are presented.
en.demo_status: Validation complete. Demonstration mode sent no information and retained no submission.
en.error_status: The request could not be sent. No external follow-up was triggered.
en.configuration_error: The website catalogue could not be loaded. Submission is disabled.
en.honeypot_error: The request could not be processed.
en.invalid_endpoint: Live intake is disabled because the configured endpoint is not HTTPS.

es.eyebrow: Sistemas pequeños y de alcance fijo para preparación internacional
es.hero_title: Haz que tu empresa sea más fácil de entender, seguir y vender internacionalmente.
es.hero_body: Empieza con una auditoría enfocada, un CRM utilizable o un documento comercial claro. Sin consultoría sobredimensionada ni promesas inventadas.

es.alpha_note: Alfa de validación: el formulario público todavía no puede transmitir datos.

es.principle_3_body: La automatización acelera el trabajo; no sustituye el criterio final.

es.neural_title: Encuentra el servicio inicial más pequeño y útil.

es.neural_goal_sales: Crear un mensaje de ventas internacional claro

es.neural_selection_applied: El servicio recomendado ha sido seleccionado en el formulario de evaluación.
es.neural_local_status: Recomendación generada localmente; no se transmitió información.
es.neural_human_review: Una persona debe confirmar el alcance y la idoneidad.
es.neural_reason_visibility: Buen encaje para claridad web internacional y confianza.
es.neural_reason_follow_up: Buen encaje para organización de leads y disciplina de seguimiento.
es.neural_reason_sales_message: Buen encaje para narrativa comercial y claridad de ventas.
es.neural_reason_contact_speed: Buen encaje para responder consultas con mayor rapidez y consistencia.
es.neural_reason_international_readiness: Se ajusta al nivel actual de preparación internacional.
es.neural_reason_multilingual: Apoya la comunicación multilingüe o entre mercados.
es.neural_reason_low_complexity: Puede iniciarse con una complejidad de implementación relativamente baja.
es.neural_reason_automation: Se ajusta a la prioridad de automatización indicada.
es.neural_reason_speed: Se ajusta a la velocidad de entrega requerida.
es.neural_reason_profitability: Equilibra la sensibilidad al precio con un resultado comercial útil.
es.fit_kicker: Diseñado para un punto de partida concreto
es.fit_title: Útil cuando el problema es concreto y la siguiente acción no está clara.
es.fit_yes_1: Pequeña empresa o negocio dirigido por sus propietarios con web, oferta o lista de leads real.
es.fit_yes_2: Problema comercial acotado que puede mejorarse en días, no meses.
es.fit_yes_3: Disponibilidad para aportar información y revisar un borrador controlado.

es.fit_no_2: Software personalizado de gran tamaño, gestión publicitaria o rebranding completo.
es.process_title: Del problema a un resultado utilizable.
es.step1_body: Confirmar la empresa, el problema, el objetivo y los datos necesarios.
es.step2_body: Acordar el entregable fijo, exclusiones, plazo y precio.
es.step3_body: Usar investigación estructurada, plantillas y automatización controlada.
es.step4_body: Control de calidad humano antes de la entrega y una revisión limitada.
es.examples_title: Prueba del método, no afirmaciones de clientes inventadas.
es.examples_body: Estas vistas previas describen los resultados previstos. No contienen información privada, testimonios ni resultados atribuidos.
